# gyro_container_sizes (Data Source)

Gyro Containers Serverless: the vCPU / memory pairs accepted for cpu_m / memory_mi of gyro_container_service in a serverless environment, and the per-hour prices (EUR, VAT excluded; per running copy, no monthly cap). Requires the billing_read scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Serverless container sizes (vCPU / memory pairs) and prices
data "gyro_container_sizes" "all" {}

output "smallest" {
  value = {
    cpu_m     = data.gyro_container_sizes.all.sizes[0].cpu_m
    memory_mi = data.gyro_container_sizes.all.sizes[0].memory_mi[0]
    eur_hour  = data.gyro_container_sizes.all.sizes[0].hourly_eur_min
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environment_max_memory_gb` (Number) Default limit of memory (GB) running at once per environment.
- `environment_max_vcpu` (Number) Default limit of vCPU running at once per environment.
- `eur_rate` (Number) EUR rate of your account currency.
- `gb_hour_eur` (Number) Price of one GB of memory for one hour.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `local_currency` (String)
- `sizes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))
- `vcpu_hour_eur` (Number) Price of one vCPU for one hour.

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_m` (Number) CPU in millicores (250 = 0.25 vCPU).
- `hourly_eur_max` (Number) Hourly price with the largest memory.
- `hourly_eur_min` (Number) Hourly price with the smallest memory.
- `memory_mi` (List of Number) Allowed memory_mi values for this cpu_m.
- `vcpu` (Number)
